summary.text: AGILERA PHARMA AS (928 041 069), a private limited company, is an active entity in Enhetsregisteret; founded 2021-11-07; address Instituttveien 18, 2007 KJELLER, Norge. Main industry is Manufacture of pharmaceutical preparations (21.200); 137 registered employees; 1 registered sub-unit(s). Daily manager: Erik Flatmark; Board chair: Etienne Louis Marie Robert Montagut; Auditor: KPMG AS. Accounts for 2025 (period ending 2025-12-31): revenue NOK 352.52 m, operating profit NOK -63.97 m, net profit NOK -69.62 m, equity NOK 18.46 m, total assets NOK 185.09 m. Official website https://agilera.no/ is verified (the org number appears on the site).
